response.sql: WITH g AS (SELECT ordersmark, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM orderexecutions GROUP BY ordersmark), t AS (SELECT CAST(SUM(cnt) AS REAL) AS total, COUNT(*) AS n FROM g), s AS (SELECT g.ordersmark, g.cnt, g.cnt / t.total AS share FROM g, t) SELECT ordersmark AS order_reference, cnt AS execution_count, share, share - (SELECT AVG(share) FROM s) AS share_minus_avg FROM s ORDER BY share_minus_avg DESC LIMIT 10
